stem.text: The structure of damascenone is shown.

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of damascenone: six-membered ring with a gem-dimethyl carbon, a ring C=C and a ring methyl group, attached to a C=O group that leads to a C=C side chain ending in CH3
stem.label: damascenone
